# API Contracts Checklist: Pilot Review Packet and Lifecycle Snapshot

**Purpose**: Validate API and artifact contract completeness for SPEC-009D packet publication and inspection.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the JSON artifact metadata and required top-level packet keys specified with stable names and schema version? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract §JSON Artifact]
- [x] CHK002 Are the Markdown artifact metadata and required reviewer sections specified with a deterministic link to the JSON artifact identity or hash? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Markdown Artifact]
- [x] CHK003 Is packet candidate eligibility complete enough to reject local-only lookalikes before any proven-pilot claim is made? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Candidate eligibility contract]
- [x] CHK004 Are deferred future-state fields specified with stable field names, owner spec IDs, state, reason code, reason, and source-map shape? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Deferral contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the optional API seam decision unambiguous about using existing task-artifact list/read routes by default and avoiding a packet-specific route unless existing seams cannot satisfy SC-001? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Artifact Surface, Contract §Existing API Surface]
- [x] CHK006 Are RFC 6901-style source-map pointer keys and supported reference fields clear enough for implementers to produce consistent packet references? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Source-map contract]
- [x] CHK007 Are JSON and Markdown consistency requirements clear about being generated from the same source snapshot and not contradicting lifecycle, gate, evidence, deferral, or warning values? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Markdown Artifact]
- [x] CHK008 Are missing, stale, superseded, oversized, malformed, redacted, and quarantined evidence states defined as packet-local values without changing existing artifact enums? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contract agree that packet artifacts are persisted through existing task-artifact storage with no new table, migration, dependency, dashboard, or poller? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Summary, Contract §Contracts Explicitly Not Created]
- [x] CHK010 Do the required artifact types, storage kinds, MIME values, and schema version align between the JSON and Markdown contracts and the data model? [Consistency, Contract §JSON Artifact, Contract §Markdown Artifact, Data Model §Packet Artifact]
- [x] CHK011 Do redaction and quarantine requirements align with existing task-artifact behavior and avoid exposing raw quarantined content, unsafe previews, storage URI, or actor identity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Evidence-state contract]
